address: 2 Chancery Street, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: There’s nothing like a big, bold brasserie for those wanting to close that business deal over an easy lunch. All the dishes on the appealing menu demonstrate that this is a kitchen with a classical culinary education. Start with the golden salt cod croquette, then you can go Italian with the selection of pasta dishes or choose something more Gallic, like braised beef cheek with escargots. Dessert is a highpoint, with favourites like Paris-Brest and zabaglione. The international wine list also offers a good selection by the glass or carafe.
